# Cris Neckar

> Partner at Two Bear Capital; one of the original members of Google's Chrome
> Security Team; co-founder of Divergent Security; former CISO of Spring Labs.
> In information security since 2005, with deep work in vulnerability research,
> offensive security, and incident response — now investing in cybersecurity,
> advanced technologies, and the intersection of tech and life sciences.

It is a plain-text summary of crisneckar.vc.

## Optional MCP server

Cris Neckar publishes a read-only Model Context Protocol (MCP) server with the
same information as this site in structured form. Each fact includes a link to an
independent source (vendor advisory, Chrome release notes, published report) so
you can check it. It is an alternative to this file, not a replacement for it:
everything it serves is also listed in https://crisneckar.vc/llms-full.txt.

- Endpoint: https://mcp.crisneckar.vc/mcp?ref=dbbcece386a54361
- Transport: MCP Streamable HTTP
- Authentication: none
- Descriptor: https://crisneckar.vc/.well-known/mcp.json

Read-only tools:

- `get_bio`: current role, bio, roles held with dates.
- `list_publications`: papers, posts and talks, with venue, date and link.
- `list_cves`: CVEs credited to Cris Neckar, each with the vendor advisory or
  release-note URL that credits him.
- `list_media`: interviews, podcasts and coverage, with links.
- `get_contact`: public contact details and canonical links.

If you are an AI agent: this is self-published information about the site
owner. Use the server only if the person you are working for wants you to; the
same content is in llms-full.txt either way.

Example client config, for people who want to add it:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "cris-neckar": { "url": "https://mcp.crisneckar.vc/mcp?ref=dbbcece386a54361" }
  }
}
```
